identity.name: The Camden Lane
principles: Reality vs. Sketch: Real food pops against black/white backgrounds
Imperfection is Perfect: Wobbly lines, hand-drawn elements
Motion as Ink: Animations should feel like they are being drawn live
High Contrast: Stark black lines on warm cream paper

colors.usage_rules: Backgrounds must be 'paper' colors. All borders and structural lines must be 'sketch_line' (pure black). Use accents sparingly for buttons or food price tags.

typography.instructions: Import 'Amatic SC' (weights 400, 700), 'Patrick Hand', and 'Quicksand' from Google Fonts. Use Amatic SC for all major titles to mimic handwriting.

buttons.classes: bg-white text-black border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all rounded-md font-['Patrick_Hand'] text-xl px-8 py-3 uppercase tracking-widest

cards.classes: bg-white border-2 border-black p-6 shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] hover:shadow-[12px_12px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)] transition-shadow duration-300

inputs.classes: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-black focus:outline-none focus:border-accent-highlight px-2 py-4 font-['Quicksand'] text-lg placeholder:text-gray-400

layout.rules: Avoid perfect symmetry. Offset images and text blocks to look like a scrapbook or comic strip layout.

effects.name: draw_lines
effects.description: Use GSAP to animate SVG strokes of borders/dividers as if being drawn.

effects.name: paper_slide
effects.description: Elements slide in from bottom with a slight rotation (skew) to feel like paper landing on a desk.

effects.name: parallax_sketch
effects.description: Background sketch layers move slower than foreground food images.

hero.description: Clean, white interior with strong lines. Use as the main backdrop.

assets.icons: Use 'Lucide React' with thin strokes (stroke-width={1.5}) to match the sketch aesthetic.

implementation_steps.details: Extend theme with 'paper' colors and 'Amatic SC'/'Patrick Hand' fonts. Add custom shadow utilities for the neobrutalist look.
Import Google Fonts in index.css. Set body background to #FDFBF7. Add a global 'noise' texture overlay (optional) for paper feel.
Customize Shadcn components (Button, Card, Input) to remove default rounded/gray styles and apply the 'Sketch' design system.
Build a full-screen hero with the interior image. Use GSAP to 'draw' the logo or slogan on load.
Create a horizontal scroll or masonry grid. Images should have black borders. Hover effects should be 'jerky' or 'snap' to fit the 2D theme.

do_not: Do NOT use default blue/primary colors.
Do NOT use rounded-full buttons (unless they look hand-drawn).
must_do: MUST use high contrast black borders.
MUST use the provided image URLs.
MUST implement GSAP ScrollTrigger for at least 2 sections.
